text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oops, if it isn't Trainer.
I'm afraid you caught me in an unsightly state.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, whenever night falls, creative inspiration
just comes gushing out of me like a fountain."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Written by me and starring me, a feature-length romance opera:
"Supreme Sovereign of the Heavens and Roses: All 26 Chapters"—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Once this masterpiece is complete, it will undoubtedly spark a revolution in the opera world...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O seemed fulfilled,
but at the same time, fatigue appeared to be catching up to her.
